versions.changelog:
xg-backtrader 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 小果量化回测系统助手, based on the Backtrader framework.
- Provides end-to-end quantitative backtesting solutions: data loading, strategy development, backtest execution, and performance analysis.
- Supports multiple asset types (stocks, futures, forex, crypto), multiple timeframes (tick, second, minute, daily, weekly, monthly), multi-strategy backtesting, and parameter optimization.
- Features comprehensive order types (market, limit, stop, stop-limit, trailing stop), commission schemes, slippage simulation, and detailed performance metrics (Sharpe, drawdown, annual returns, etc.).
- Includes a detailed code template for double moving average strategies with explanations and best practices.
- User guidance covers all core Backtrader components and workflow.
